microservices-reliability.title: Reliable Java Microservices
microservices-reliability.problem: A failure, slow response or scaling issue in one service can affect the reliability and performance of the overall application.
engineeringDecisions: Use controlled retries only where safe
Protect critical service dependencies from cascading failures

prototype.description: A small REST API demonstrating controller-service separation and controlled downstream interaction.

secure-api.title: Secure REST APIs
secure-api.problem: Backend APIs need controlled access, validated input and predictable security and error handling.
engineeringDecisions: Authenticate requests before accessing protected resources
Apply authorization at the appropriate boundary
Avoid exposing sensitive information in errors

prototype.description: A simplified Spring Boot API showing the protected endpoint boundary.

api-performance.title: High-Performance REST APIs
api-performance.problem: Increasing traffic, inefficient processing and application or database bottlenecks can increase API latency and reduce system throughput.
engineeringDecisions: Monitor latency and throughput after optimization

prototype.description: A simplified service boundary showing where caching and efficient data access can reduce repeated database work.

production-incident.title: Production Incident & RCA
production-incident.problem: Production incidents require rapid impact assessment, evidence-based troubleshooting and prevention of recurrence.
engineeringDecisions: Identify the affected service and business impact

prototype.description: A lightweight incident-response flow showing how a production issue can be investigated.
prototype.code:
```text
Alert
  ↓
Identify Impact
  ↓
Check Logs + Metrics
  ↓
Isolate Service
  ↓
Find Root Cause
  ↓
Mitigate
  ↓
Validate
  ↓
Prevent Recurrence
```

observability.title: Production Observability
observability.problem: Distributed applications are difficult to troubleshoot when logs, metrics and request context are disconnected.
engineeringDecisions: Use evidence from logs and metrics during RCA

prototype.description: A simplified logging example showing request context that can be correlated during production troubleshooting.

cloud-scalability.title: Cloud Scalability
cloud-scalability.problem: Applications need to maintain predictable performance and availability while traffic and resource demand change.

prototype.description: A simplified deployment model showing multiple application instances behind a load balancer.
prototype.code:
```text
Users
  ↓
Load Balancer
  ↓
┌───────────────┐
│ Spring Boot   │
│ Instance 1    │
├───────────────┤
│ Spring Boot   │
│ Instance 2    │
└───────────────┘
       ↓
   Monitoring
       ↓
   Autoscaling
```

data-consistency.title: Data Consistency Across Services
data-consistency.problem: Independent microservices make cross-service state changes harder to keep consistent.

prototype.description: A simplified service flow demonstrating eventual consistency and compensation.
prototype.code:
```text
Order Service
     ↓
Payment Request
     ↓
Payment Service
     ↓
Payment Success
     ↓
Order Confirmed

If Payment Fails
     ↓
Compensation / Retry
```

caching.title: Caching for Read Performance
caching.problem: Repeated reads can create unnecessary database load and increase API response time.
engineeringDecisions: Avoid stale data where business impact is high

prototype.description: A simple cache-aside pattern for frequently requested data.
prototype.code:
```text
Request
  ↓
Check Cache
  ↓
Hit? ── Yes ──→ Return
  │
  No
  ↓
Database
  ↓
Update Cache
  ↓
Return
```

ci-cd.title: Reliable CI/CD
ci-cd.problem: Frequent releases require repeatable validation and deployment rather than manual and error-prone steps.
engineeringDecisions: Keep rollback or recovery options available

prototype.description: A simplified pipeline showing the core validation stages before production deployment.
prototype.code:
```text
Git Commit
    ↓
Maven Build
    ↓
Unit Tests
    ↓
Quality Checks
    ↓
Artifact
    ↓
Deploy
    ↓
Smoke Test
```

testing.title: Quality Through Automated Testing
testing.problem: Fast delivery without automated validation increases regression risk.
engineeringDecisions: Cover important business logic with unit tests
Use integration tests for service boundaries
Run tests as part of CI/CD

prototype.description: A simple unit-test structure for validating service behaviour.

ai-assisted-engineering.title: AI-Assisted Engineering
ai-assisted-engineering.problem: AI capabilities or AI-assisted engineering can improve product functionality and developer productivity while engineering quality, security and human review remain essential.
engineeringDecisions: Use AI for appropriate development or product tasks
Keep human approval in the delivery process

prototype.description: A controlled workflow for using AI coding assistance without removing engineering review.
prototype.code:
```text
Requirement
    ↓
AI Assistance
    ↓
Engineer Review
    ↓
Unit Tests
    ↓
Security / Quality Checks
    ↓
Production
```
